senses.gloss: f. (זָכָר; cmp. Lat. fascinum = witchraft a. membrum virile) necromantic incantation (by means of a membrum); necromantic apparition.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 65b:9">Snh. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>המעלה בז׳</he> he who conjures up the dead by means of &c.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11">Gen. R. s. 11</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:10:9">Y. Snh. VII, 25ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26">Lev. R. s. 26</cite>.—Snh. l. c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 918:3">Yalk. Deut. 918</cite> (interpret. <he>מעונן</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:11">Deut. XVIII, 11</cite>, fr. <cite ref="P00291"><he>עוּן</he></cite>) <he>המעביר שבעה מיני זָכוּר על העיו</he> (Ar. ed. Koh. <he>זמר זכורן</he>, cler. error) he who lets pass before one’s eyes seven sorts of apparitions; (Sifra K’dosh. Par. 3, ch. VI; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 171:8">Sifré Deut. 171</cite> <he>מעביר על העין</he> only).
